requirement: SPEC.md section 4, and the compatibility contract above
note: One derivation, one set of checks and one evaluation pass over whole documents. The refusals are asked in the order the checks run, because an undeclared slot is reported before a dangling reference and a dangling reference before a cycle, and an edge set nobody trusts would make a later check prove nothing. The chain of four hundred is the one that shows the sort carries its own stack: a recursive one would run out of frames on either engine. A pass answers with the objects it was given, each slot under the key it arrived with, so the comparison reads the slot order as well as the values and would catch a pass that added or dropped one. The check for an illegal number literal inside a stored tree has no case here, because every formula in a fixture is parsed from source and no source spells one. A tree carrying one arrives through the document decoder, so RUST-012 is where that check gets a case.
